coverage.note: Eight queued articles read; two named a street address. Six named none: a surrogacy-escrow fraud charge, a Pier 70 event venue opening given only as the pier, a Mission street-conditions story, a free concert series on Fulton Plaza, a student's web game, and a police chase. Both addressed stories are declined below.

findings.description: The same Rize Up Bakery cafe opening at 1160 Howard Street reported by The San Francisco Standard on the same day. Hoodline gives the same facts — a cafe in the bakery's SoMa production warehouse, after a burglary and a flood each costing over $100,000 — and adds that the warehouse runs to 22,000 square feet.

citation.label: Hoodline, “SF's First Black-Owned Sourdough Bakery Rize Up Opens SoMa Cafe After Two Disasters,” 27 August 2026

raw.text: …000-square-foot SoMa production warehouse, a milestone that comes after the business survived a burglary and a flood, each costing more than $100,000

publish.note: One entry per dated event. The same opening is published on 1160 Howard Street from The San Francisco Standard, whose report carries the address in its own information box; a second headline for one event would make the timeline read as though two things happened.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 1160 HOWARD ST → parcel 3727024; sf-parcels has blklot 3727024 active, 1160–1160 HOWARD; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1924.

findings.description: A touring comedian is announced for a show at the Curran Theatre, 445 Geary Street. Nothing in the story is about the building; the address is where a booking will be performed.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Becky Robinson Brings Her Viral Entitled Housewife to SF's Curran Theatre,” 27 August 2026
citation.locator: body, the paragraph naming the theatre

publish.note: Fails the ten-year test twice over. A single booking at a theatre is not a fact about the theatre — it is the venue of an event, which news/AGENTS.md names as the classic non-story — and the headline names a private individual who is not an architect, builder, developer or firm, so the headline could not be published even if the story had earned an entry.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 445 GEARY ST → parcel 0316018A; sf-parcels has blklot 0316018A active, 445–445 GEARY; the 2025 roll records it as commercial misc, built 1922.
resolution.note: No page at this path yet; the parcel is the publisher's to seed.
